home.metaTitle: Matcha Wholesale Supplier — Bulk Matcha & Superfoods at Origin
home.metaDescription: Bulk matcha and superfood powders for manufacturers — single-origin, lab-tested every batch (JAS, EU & USDA Organic), from sample to full container. Superfoods Partners sources direct from origin. Request a quote.
home.heroIntro: We buy directly at the farm, control the chain from harvest to pallet, and supply brands, manufacturers and private label with matcha, hojicha, hibiscus, ube and lion's mane.
home.peopleHeading: The source is a relationship, not a transaction.
home.peopleBody: We buy directly from growers we know by name, in regions we return to season after season. Their care for the soil is the first quality check — long before the lab. When we say “trusted at origin,” we mean there is a person standing at that origin, and we have shaken their hand.

peopleItems.d: Long-term contracts and fair pricing that let farms invest in the land.
Shade-grown, low-intervention practices, protected across generations.
A name, a place and a coordinate behind every batch we ship.

home.peopleCaption: A GROWER IN THE GARDENS AT HARVEST
home.sourceBody: Every company is Superfoods Partners — one umbrella with local operating entities in Hong Kong, the Netherlands and the United States. Tap a location to focus the office; the commercial labels sit underneath and are shared across all of them.
home.traceBody: Pick a product and follow it from origin to your facility. Every batch arrives with a full Verification Record — the same checks we'd want if we were the ones buying. Nothing hidden, nothing to chase down.
home.stepsBody: Tell us what you need; we handle origin, testing and documentation — and keep you in the loop the whole way. You approve before anything scales.

steps.d: Product, grade, volume and market. A short brief is enough to get going.
You taste, test and approve — before anything scales to volume.
A Verification Record and full COA travel with every batch.
FOB, CIF or DDP — every batch documented, in 2–4 weeks.

home.hkCoords: Hong Kong · Amsterdam · Salt Lake City
home.hkHeading: Close to origin, close to you.
home.hkBody1: We run from three locations — Hong Kong, Amsterdam and Salt Lake City — so we sit close to the gardens we buy from and close to the manufacturers we supply. Every lot is tested and documented before it ships, wherever it's headed.
home.hkBody2: And there are people behind it: a team you can reach in your own timezone, who actually pick up the phone.
home.socialHeading: For teams who can't afford a bad batch.
home.socialBody: Beverage, supplement and foodservice brands come to us when consistency isn't optional — and stay because the documentation is always there when they need it.
home.socialQuote: “They catch the things we'd miss — and when our auditors ask for paperwork, it's already there.”
home.socialQuoteAttr: Head of Procurement · EU beverage brand
home.ctaBody: Tell us what you need and at what scale. We'll source, verify and document it — and ship it to you.

about.metaTitle: Company — the trusted superfood sourcing partner
about.metaDescription: Superfoods Partners is an international supplier of single-origin superfood powders, operating from Hong Kong, Amsterdam and Salt Lake City. Pure Matcha Partners is our specialist matcha brand.
about.heroBody1: Superfoods Partners is the umbrella for our group — one shared portfolio of single-origin superfood powders, with local operating entities in Hong Kong, the Netherlands and the United States. We buy direct from the farms and move large, verified volumes to manufacturers, brands and private label.
about.heroBody2: We don't aspire to be the largest supplier. We aspire to be the one you never have to worry about.
about.heroCaption: A GROWER IN THE GARDENS AT HARVEST
about.groupBody: Every company is Superfoods Partners — one umbrella with local operating entities in Hong Kong, the Netherlands and the United States. The commercial labels sit underneath and are shared across all of them; Pure Matcha Partners is our specialist matcha brand today.
about.houseBody: Superfoods Partners is the house — the company, the origins, the supplier relationships. Beneath it sit specialist labels, each one owning a category and proving what the material can do. A product reaches you under one of those labels, or under your own brand with our name behind it.
about.houseUmbrellaBody: The company and the chain — every origin, every lot, every location. All the ranges, bulk and private label.
about.housePmpBody: Our specialist matcha brand — matcha and hojicha, packed and branded, with its own identity.
about.houseSoonBody: The model scales by category. New specialist labels join the house as ranges mature.
about.houseRouteOwnBody: When we pack and brand it ourselves — as with Pure Matcha Partners — the label stands behind the material. Our own labels prove what it can do.
about.houseRoutePrivBody: For private label, your brand goes on the pack and ours stands behind it as an endorsement — proof of where the material came from and how it was tested.
